events.title: Solo Leveling: The Exhibition

events.overview: Japan's first immersive exhibition for Solo Leveling, built around the series' biggest arcs: walk-through sets, large-format art and photo spots themed to Sung Jin-Woo's rise. Entry is by date-and-time ticket, so book before you go.

events.title: Lupin the Third 55th Anniversary Pop-Up
events.overview: A pop-up for 55 years of Lupin the Third, built around art styles from across the franchise's history: apparel and an artist collaboration with JUN INAGAWA. Items are first come, first served while stock lasts, and the store may limit how many you can buy. Some items sell online later on ZOZOTOWN, partly by lottery or pre-order.

events.overview: A fine-jewelry line based on the Soul Gems and Dark Orbs from Madoka Magica: sterling silver necklaces, plus a limited run of 18K gold and platinum miniature figures. Sold by reservation and shipped with a wooden keepsake case. Many pieces are made to order. You can see them in person, without a booking, at two U-TREASURE stores.

events.title: Haikyu!! × Ootoya
events.jp: 大戸屋×ハイキュー!! コラボキャンペーン
events.overview: Ootoya's second Haikyu!! collaboration: set meals designed after rival schools from the series (Date Tech, Fukurodani, Inarizaki and more), Each set meal comes with one random hologram postcard (first half) or sticker (second half). There is also a dessert plate for ¥680. About 24,000 sets are planned, and the menu ends when they sell out.
